metadata.title: Doh Sniang Nei-iong | Khasi Style Pork With Sesame
metadata.description: Doh sniang iong is a delicious and authentic Khasi dish from the Northeastern state of Meghalaya. Pork meat is cooked with roasted and pounded sesame seeds, which gives it a distinct nutty flavor. It is served with steamed rice or Khasi rice cakes called Putharo. It's simple and easy to make.
